inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: There was a plastic bouquet of flowers in the infant classroom in a basket on the shelves that was accessible to a mobile infant.  The end of the stem was observed to be sharp.  The plastic bouquet came from the Pre-K classroom teacher as part of "real" items that are part of Texas Rising Stars curriculum.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: The toddler classroom was observed to have an electrical outlet without outlet covers on it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: One child's file did not have updated information regarding the Dtap.  The child is two years-old and shows only two vaccinations given before he was 12 months old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: A child was observed walking around the classroom with food in each hand.     This was corrected at inspection when the child was brought to the table and provided a napkin to place the food on.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Three out of ten children's files did not have up-to-date immunization records available to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child: Based on the DFPS investigation, the caregiver had an infant on the changing table but turned around to get something behind them without keeping a hand on the infant's body.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: Based on the DFPS investigation, a caregiver used a negative statement when interacting with a child and grabbed the child's face while removing an object from the child's mouth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Location of Handwashing Sink: Based on the DFPS investigation, soap and water were not available to wash hands after diaper changing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.4405)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of caregivers-Set appropriate behavior expectations: Based on the DFPS investigation, A child under the age of one year was placed in a crib as a form of time-out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Based on the DFPS investigation, a daily infant feeding form was not completed and signed by the parent for the month of October.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined in an investigation that good judgment was not utilized by a caregiver during an infant's feeding, when the caregiver was observed to be aggressive by forcefully inserting the bottle into the infant's mouth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Tables and Chairs Safe, Easy to Clean and Appropriate in Size: It was determined in an investigation that the chairs utilized by toddler-aged children were not age-appropriate, which resulted in a child falling and sustaining a bump to their head.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Tables and Chairs Safe, Easy to Clean and Appropriate in Size (26 TAC §746.4501(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): One of the five staff files reviewed were missing a notarized affidavit for review
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings: It was observed that a portion of the fence was not secure between the big playground and the basketball playground, allowing children to put their bodies through it. Additionally, on the basketball playground, a section of the fence leading to the other side, where the apartment complex is, was also not secure, permitting children to climb through to the other side.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(3))

occurrences.finding: Location of Handwashing Sink: Based on the DFPS investigation, soap and water were not available to wash hands after diaper changing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.4405)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Based on the DFPS investigation, a daily infant feeding form was not completed and signed by the parent for the month of October.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child: Based on the DFPS investigation, the caregiver had an infant on the changing table but turned around to get something behind them without keeping a hand on the infant's body.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: Based on the DFPS investigation, a caregiver used a negative statement when interacting with a child and grabbed the child's face while removing an object from the child's mouth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach: During the walk, the hose was on the ground and laid out on the playground where children could access it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.5015(c))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: During the review of the monthly emergency practices, the fire extinguisher did not have examination dates available for January through April.  *Corrected at inspection was noted when the director inspected all the fire extinguishers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two out of ten chidren files reviewed were missing emergency contacts; it was only parent information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver was over ratio by 4 children. Caregiver was on the playground with 15 children with a specified age group of 2 years.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left alone on the playground unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: There was no documentation of smoke detector testing since 12/28/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Four of nine of employee records reviewed did not have a complete affidavit on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There was a hole in fence that surround the play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Nine of nine staff files reviewed did not have a current certificate in pediatric first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: There was no documentation of carbon monoxide detector checks since 12/28/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: There was no documentation of monthly fire extinguisher checks since 12/28/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director did not have two hours of transportation safety training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child did not wash their hands after toileting.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when the child washed their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: Television observed in the school aged classroom was not anchored.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §746.3701(10))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The electronic child safety alarm was observed not functioning in one of the operation's vans used to transport the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: 3 out of the 8 staff records reviewed were missing  documentation of how they met the minimum education requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: 1 out of the 8 staff files reviewed did not have a current certifcate in pediatric first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation had not had a sanitation inspection conducted within the last 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: 2 out of the 8 staff records reviewed were missing a notarized employment affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There was a screw exposed on the play kitchen sink in the pre-k classroom.     There was debris underneath the two different diaper changing mats.    Note. The screw was removed from the play kitchen. The diaper changing stations were sanitize.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There were five infants with one caregiver in the infant room. Three of those infants were under 12 months old.      Note. A second caregiver was assign to the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Three staff did not have current training on child maltreatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Two staff did not have current training on SID's, and Shaken Baby Syndrome.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022 revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022 as required by field communication #340.     Note. Operation complied after the required due date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
